T: Two men, one pair of skates, plenty of snacks.
D: Two rival figure skaters banned from singles competition team up as the first all-male pairs team.
P: Serve the snacks when Chazz and Jimmy first take the ice together.
S: Warm soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, with mustard and a cheese dip for the stands.
Chilli garlic prawns, hot off the grill, served on a bed of crushed ice with lime for the cold side.
M: the big night at the championships
Crumbed chicken breast topped with tomato sauce, ham and melted cheese, with chips and salad, a proper competition dinner.
W: the Iron Lotus, the move nobody survives
Coconut-coated vanilla ice cream balls rolled through white chocolate, frozen hard and served like little snowballs.
K: thawing out after practice on the ice

Thick hot chocolate made with dark chocolate and milk, a hint of peppermint, topped with whipped cream and crushed candy canes. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling. Stir in half a tsp peppermint essence. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour the chocolate into 4 mugs, top with the cream and scatter with 2 crushed candy canes.

s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip each in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with 30g melted butter and serve with mustard and 200g cheese sauce.
Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and salt. Grill on high for 2 minutes a side. Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve with lime wedges.

m.note: the big night at the championships
m.how: Halve 2 large chicken breasts into thin fillets. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g breadcrumbs and pan-fry until golden. Top with 200g passata, 4 slices ham and 150g grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Serve with chips and salad.

w.note: the Iron Lotus, the move nobody survives
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 8 balls and freeze for 1 hour. Melt 200g white chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil, dip each ball and roll straight away in 100g desiccated coconut. Freeze until serving.

d.note: thawing out after practice on the ice
d.how: Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling. Stir in half a tsp peppermint essence. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour the chocolate into 4 mugs, top with the cream and scatter with 2 crushed candy canes.
